7.1.2 General requirements
This chapter lists requirements that shall be fulfilled by Cellular V2X Driver module implementations. The Cellular V2X Driver module environment comprises all modules which are calling interfaces of the Cellular V2X Driver module.
[CP_SWS_CV2x_00012] Status: DRAFT
⌈The Cellular V2X Driver shall ensure that the base addresses of all reception and transmission buffers fulfill the memory alignment requirements for all AUTOSAR data types of the respective platform such that efficient DMA and Memcopy operations are possible.⌋
[CP_SWS_CV2x_00013] Status: DRAFT
⌈The Cellular V2X Driver shall call EthIf_TxConfirmation to indicate a successful transmission from the Interrupt routine (if the notification has been enabled through EthIfTxConfirmationFunction).⌋
[CP_SWS_CV2x_00014] Status: DRAFT
⌈The Cellular V2X Driver shall call EthIf_RxIndication to indicate a successful reception from the Interrupt routine.⌋
